name: Thiopental
summary: Barbiturate that that has a reportedly fast onset. The drug is used as for anesthesia in medical induced comas among other things.

pharmacology.text: Sodium thiopental is a member of the barbiturate class of drugs, which are relatively non-selective compounds that bind to an entire superfamily of ligand-gated ion channels, of which the GABAA receptor channel is one of several representatives. This superfamily of ion channels includes the neuronal nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (nAChR), the 5-HT3 receptor, the glycine receptor and others.

uses.text: Sodium thiopental, also known as thiopental sodium or thiopentone and sold under the brand name Pentothal, is a rapid-onset short-acting barbiturate general anesthetic. Sodium thiopental is a therapeutic alternative on the World Health Organization's List of Essential Medicines. Although thiopental abuse carries a dependency risk, its recreational use is rare.
